content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered (PD#12345) — control-plane: elevated 5xx and timeouts across auth, org-lookup and config routes. Creating incident channel and paging on-call.

pagerduty-bot: paging maya, sanjay, dana — escalation policy: control-plane-critical.

maya: seeing a big jump in 5xx starting ~4991229800, spike across eu-west + us-west. Error rate ~6.8% on /v1/chat and /v1/auth/lookup. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/controlplane/errors (link).

sanjay: oncall here. attaching quick flame graphs and logs. looks related to upstream billing timeouts causing auth to return 502s.

dana: customer impact — some customers are seeing auth failures during login and model requests failing with 502. Support ticket volume rising. Flagging high severity.

lee: I can repro a 502 from auth when it calls billing-accounts. sample curl:
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://controlplane.internal/auth/lookup -d '{"org_id":"org_123"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer token"
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Thu, 07 Mar 2026 14:20:10 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream_timeout","upstream":"billing-accounts","trace":"trace-id-9ab3"}
```

ops-runner: logging shows billing-accounts pod 0/3 ready in eu-west, retries/backpressure. kube events: OOMKilled on billing-accounts and high GC.

maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle control-plane requests to billing path, 2) route auth requests to read-only cache (org lookup cache) for 10m, 3) scale billing-accounts deployment, 4) flip circuit-breaker to return cached org metadata.

sanjay: doing quick config change to enable cached fallback. running:
```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/auth-service USE_ORG_CACHE=true --record
kubectl -n controlplane scale deploy/billing-accounts --replicas=6
```

ops-runner: applied scale to 6 replicas in eu-west/us-west, rolling restart in progress. watch logs: `kubectl -n controlplane logs deploy/billing-accounts -f`

dana: Messaging — posting support banner and status page update. Draft: "We are investigating elevated control-plane errors causing intermittent 502 responses for auth and model requests. Mitigations in progress." Will coordinate on followups.

lee: also raising connection timeout from 2s -> 5s between auth->billing to reduce circuit churn. Patch pushed to staging, will rollout canary 10%.

sanjay: canary looks ok for 10% traffic, no increased latency observed. Rolling the timeout patch to 50% now.

oncall-bot: Incident timeline note added: root cause suspected: billing-accounts memory leak + cascading retries causing auth upstream 502s.

maya: current metrics after cache fallback: error rate down to 2.1% (from 6.8%). Auth 5xx reduced to ~1.2%. Still monitoring for residual spikes.

ops-runner: billing-accounts pods show reduced OOMs after scale and GC tuning. logs: `gc pause reduced from 200ms -> 30ms`.

dana: Customer impact assessment: ~1200 API keys affected intermittently; estimated error windows between 14:18-14:34 UTC. No data loss. Recommend proactive email to top 10 affected customers.

lee: preparing a hotfix for billing-accounts leak (patch PR opened: https://gh.internal/redwood/billing/pull/987). If tests pass we'll hotpatch tomorrow morning if stable.

sanjay: next steps for on-call: 1) keep cache-fallback for 30m, 2) monitor for 1 hour, 3) if stable, revert extended timeouts to normal and remove cache-fallback, 4) schedule postmortem and RCA.

maya: handing off to night on-call (dana) in 30m. dana, take ownership and raise pager if regressions.

dana: acknowledged — I'll keep watch and escalate to eng-sre if error rate >3% for 15m. Preparing initial postmortem template and capturing timeline.

pagerduty-bot: on-call handover: maya -> dana at 4991230300.

oncall-bot: final note: Support banner posted, top customers notified by PMs, hotfix PR opened, cache-fallback stabilized traffic. Will run full RCA and timeline once hotfix confirmed. :white_check_mark:
